name: Nguyễn Hoà
headline: A notebook of useful AI.
intro: I build personal assistants, agent memory, and retrieval tools — with room for a little curiosity.
focus: Small loops, useful tools, MCP, and A2A.
Context, hybrid search, embeddings, and reranking.
GGUF experiments, LM Studio, and practical benchmarks.
Python, developer skills, and thoughtful interfaces.

projects.title: Thyca
projects.summary: A personal assistant harness for the terminal and a local WebUI. One agent loop, tools, skills, and MCP; Markdown memory with SQLite lexical search.

projects.title: Another Brain
projects.summary: Shared, local memory for AI coding agents. SQLite, full-text and vector search, local ONNX embeddings, and a diary that expires unless reinforced.

projects.title: March7 & Evernight
projects.summary: A Discord assistant with two independent agents connected over A2A. Shared memory and background consolidation; the self-heal framework is still in development.

projects.title: RAG
projects.summary: PDF retrieval with semantic search and BM25, query enhancement, and reranking. A modular stack with multiple LLM and embedding providers.

projects.title: Agent Skills
projects.summary: Reusable skills, instructions, and prompt templates for AI coding agents: planning, implementation, debugging, review, and architecture documentation.
